<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>crazy Journey｜かずちん &amp; ジュニア</title>
<meta name="description" content="誰も見たことのない景色を、言葉で広げる。かずちんとジュニア、二人の大親友が夢・将来・趣味・価値観を発信するブログ。">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Shippori+Mincho+B1:wght@500;700&family=Zen+Kaku+Gothic+New:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #F4F2EC;
    --bg-sub: #EDEAE2;
    --ink: #16181D;
    --ink-2: #3A3C41;
    --muted: #5A5C61;
    --line: #D9D5CB;
    --placeholder: #DCD8CE;
    --accent: #A2401C;       /* テーマカラー：ここを変えると全体の差し色が変わります */
    --accent-dark: #E9A07F;  /* 黒背景の上で使う差し色 */
    --serif: 'Shippori Mincho B1', serif;
    --sans: 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', sans-serif;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); line-height: 1.8; }
  a { color: var(--ink); }
  a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
  img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
  .section { padding: 96px 0; }
  .bg-sub { background: var(--bg-sub); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .bg-dark { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); }

  .eyebrow { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .2em; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
  .bg-dark .eyebrow { color: var(--accent-dark); }
  .h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; }
  .lead { margin: 0 0 48px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .bg-dark .lead { color: #C9C6BE; }
  .section-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
  .section-head .h2 { margin: 0; }
  .more-link { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }

  /* 画像が入るまでの仮枠 */
  .ph { background: var(--placeholder); color: #4E5056; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
  .ph img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

  /* Header */
  .header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; }
  .header .container { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 24px; padding-top: 16px; padding-bottom: 16px; }
  .logo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-decoration: none; line-height: 1.3; }
  .logo-name { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }
  .logo-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
  .nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
  .nav a { text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 0; }

  /* Hero（背景スライドショー） */
  .hero { position: relative; min-height: min(88vh, 860px); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; overflow: hidden; color: #fff; background: var(--ink); padding: 140px 0 120px; }
  .hero-slides { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
  .hero-slide { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.08); transition: opacity 1.6s ease, transform 8s linear; }
  .hero-slide.is-active { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  .hero-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,12,16,.82) 0%, rgba(10,12,16,.45) 45%, rgba(10,12,16,.25) 100%); }
  .hero-inner { position: relative; width: 100%; }
  .hero .eyebrow { color: var(--accent-dark); }
  .hero h1 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(34px, 6vw, 72px); line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: .02em; text-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
  .hero-text { margin: 28px 0 0; max-width: 620px; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.92); }
  .btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin-top: 40px; }
  .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; text-decoration: none; border: 1.5px solid #fff; }
  .btn-light { background: #fff; color: var(--ink); }
  .btn-light:hover { background: var(--accent-dark); border-color: var(--accent-dark); color: var(--ink); }
  .btn-ghost { color: #fff; }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #fff; }
  .hero-controls { position: absolute; right: 24px; bottom: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .hero-dots { display: flex; gap: 2px; }
  .hero-dot { width: 32px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; position: relative; }
  .hero-dot::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 4px; right: 4px; top: 21px; height: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.45); transition: background .3s; }
  .hero-dot[aria-current="true"]::after { background: #fff; }
  .hero-pause { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7); background: rgba(0,0,0,.2); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; }
  .hero-pause .i-play { display: none; }
  .hero-pause[aria-pressed="true"] .i-play { display: block; }
  .hero-pause[aria-pressed="true"] .i-pause { display: none; }

  /* Gallery（自動スライド） */
  .g-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
  .g-btn { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; }
  .g-btn:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); }
  .g-track { display: flex; gap: 20px; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scroll-behavior: smooth; padding: 0 max(24px, calc((100vw - 1152px) / 2)) 16px; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .g-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .g-track:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }
  .g-item { flex: 0 0 auto; width: clamp(240px, 28vw, 360px); margin: 0; scroll-snap-align: start; }
  .g-item img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--placeholder); }
  .g-item figcaption { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }

  /* Concept */
  .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 40px; }
  .concept-word { display: block; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 48px; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .concept p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); }

  /* About */
  .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 32px; }
  .profile { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .profile .ph { height: 420px; border-radius: 0; }
  .profile-body { padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  .profile-label { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .15em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
  .profile h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 28px; }
  .profile p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .profile dl { margin: 8px 0 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9em 1fr; gap: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; }
  .profile dt { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
  .profile dd { margin: 0; }
  .profile-link { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .friendship { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 720px; }
  .friend-row { margin-top: 56px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 40px; align-items: center; }
  .friend-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
  .friend-photo img { object-position: 50% 45%; }

  /* Themes */
  .themes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 1px; background: #3A3C41; border: 1px solid #3A3C41; }
  .theme-card { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); text-decoration: none; padding: 40px 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-height: 220px; transition: background .2s; }
  .theme-card:hover { background: #22252B; color: var(--bg); }
  .theme-no { font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent-dark); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .theme-name { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }
  .theme-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #C9C6BE; }
  .theme-more { margin-top: auto; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }

  /* Journal */
  .filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
  .filter { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
  .filter[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); }
  .posts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 32px; }
  .post { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  .post[hidden] { display: none; }
  .post .ph { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; font-size: 13px; }
  /* 表紙：写真を切らずに全体を表示し、余白は同じ写真をぼかして埋める */
  .cover { position: relative; background: #2A2C31; }
  .cover .cover-bg { position: absolute; inset: -20px; width: calc(100% + 40px); height: calc(100% + 40px); object-fit: cover; filter: blur(18px) brightness(.75); }
  .cover .cover-main { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
  .post-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
  .tag { padding: 2px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink); }
  .post h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .post p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .post a { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
  .empty { display: none; font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); }

  .note-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .note-link-pending, .profile-link-pending { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
  .filter-label { align-self: center; min-width: 4.5em; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
  .filters + .filters { margin-top: -28px; }
  .author-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); }
  .author-chip::before, .filter-author[data-who]::before, .note-link::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--who, var(--ink)); flex: 0 0 auto; }
  .note-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .filter-author { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  [data-who="かずちん"] { --who: var(--accent); }
  [data-who="ジュニア"] { --who: #1F5E63; }
  .sns-pending { color: var(--muted); }
  .post-new { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; }

  /* News */
  .news-section { padding-bottom: 72px; }
  .news-updated { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
  .news-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .news-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.5em 6.5em 1fr; gap: 8px 20px; align-items: baseline; padding: 20px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15px; }
  .news-item time { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .news-label { justify-self: start; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); white-space: nowrap; }
  .news-label-info { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); }
  .news-text a { text-decoration: none; }
  .news-text a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .news-new { margin-left: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: .05em; }
  .news-empty { padding: 20px 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }

  /* Vlog */
  .vlog { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; text-decoration: none; }
  .vlog-thumb { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #2A2C31; border-radius: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  .vlog-meta { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
  .vlog-title { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; }

  /* SNS */
  .sns-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
  .sns { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 24px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s; }
  .sns:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
  .sns-name { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; }
  .sns-use { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
  .sns-id { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 8px; }

  /* Message */
  .narrow { max-width: 760px; }
  .form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
  .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .field label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .field input, .field select, .field textarea { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; border: 1px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 4px; background: #22252B; color: var(--bg); font-family: inherit; }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-dark); outline-offset: 1px; }
  .submit { align-self: flex-start; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
  .submit:hover { background: var(--accent-dark); }
  .form-note { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--accent-dark); min-height: 1.8em; }

  /* Footer */
  .footer { border-top: 1px solid #3A3C41; background: var(--ink); color: #C9C6BE; }
  .footer .container { padding-top: 40px; padding-bottom: 40px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-size: 13px; }
  .footer-logo { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 18px; color: var(--bg); }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .hero-slide { transition: opacity .01s; transform: none !important; }
    .g-track { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .section { padding: 72px 0; }
    .hero { padding: 96px 0 112px; min-height: 80vh; }
    .hero-controls { left: 24px; right: auto; bottom: 24px; }
    .header { position: static; }
    .concept-word { font-size: 40px; }
    .profile dl { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; }
    .profile dd { margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .news-item { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; }
    .news-text { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ===== ヘッダー ===== -->
<header class="header">
  <div class="container">
    <a href="#top" class="logo">
      <span class="logo-name">crazy Journey</span>
      <span class="logo-sub">かずちん &amp; ジュニア</span>
    </a>
    <nav class="nav" aria-label="メインメニュー">
      <a href="#about">二人について</a>
      <a href="#news">ニュース</a>
      <a href="#gallery">ギャラリー</a>
      <a href="#themes">テーマ</a>
      <a href="#journal">記事</a>
      <a href="#vlog">Vlog</a>
      <a href="#sns">公式SNS</a>
      <a href="#message">メッセージ</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>

<!-- ===== メインビジュアル（背景スライドショー） ===== -->
<!-- 写真を増やすときは hero-slide の img を1行追加し、下の hero-dot ボタンも1つ増やしてください -->
<section id="top" class="hero">
  <div class="hero-slides" aria-hidden="true">
      <img class="hero-slide is-active" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position: 50% 40%">
      <img class="hero-slide" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position: 50% 40%">
      <img class="hero-slide" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position: 50% 35%">
      <img class="hero-slide" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position: 50% 50%">
      <img class="hero-slide" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="" style="object-position: 50% 30%">
  </div>
  <div class="hero-scrim"></div>
  <div class="container hero-inner">
    <p class="eyebrow">TWO FRIENDS, ONE HORIZON</p>
    <h1>誰も見たことのない景色を、<br>言葉で広げる。</h1>
    <p class="hero-text">かずちんとジュニア。二人の大親友が、それぞれの夢、将来、趣味、価値観を言葉にして届けるブログです。誰かの人生に共感したい、あなたへ。</p>
    <div class="btns">
      <a href="#journal" class="btn btn-light">最新の記事を読む</a>
      <a href="#about" class="btn btn-ghost">二人について</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-controls">
    <div class="hero-dots">
      <button type="button" class="hero-dot" aria-label="写真1を表示" aria-current="true"></button>
      <button type="button" class="hero-dot" aria-label="写真2を表示"></button>
      <button type="button" class="hero-dot" aria-label="写真3を表示"></button>
      <button type="button" class="hero-dot" aria-label="写真4を表示"></button>
      <button type="button" class="hero-dot" aria-label="写真5を表示"></button>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="hero-pause" aria-label="スライドを一時停止" aria-pressed="false">
      <svg class="i-pause" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="1" width="3.5" height="12" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="8.5" y="1" width="3.5" height="12" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
      <svg class="i-play" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 1l10 6-10 6z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
    </button>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== ニュース（noteの更新を自動で告知） ===== -->
<!-- noteの新着は data/posts.json から自動で表示されます。手動のお知らせは data/news.json に追加してください -->
<section id="news" class="section news-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div>
        <p class="eyebrow">NEWS</p>
        <h2 class="h2">お知らせ</h2>
      </div>
      <p class="news-updated" id="news-updated"></p>
    </div>
    <ul class="news-list" id="news-list">
      <li class="news-item"><time>[YYYY.MM.DD]</time><span class="news-label">note更新</span><span class="news-text">かずちんがnoteを更新しました「[記事タイトル]」</span></li>
      <li class="news-item"><time>[YYYY.MM.DD]</time><span class="news-label news-label-info">お知らせ</span><span class="news-text">crazy Journey を公開しました。</span></li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== コンセプト ===== -->
<section class="section bg-sub">
  <div class="container">
    <h2 class="h2" style="margin-bottom:48px">このブログについて</h2>
    <div class="grid-3">
      <div class="concept">
        <span class="concept-word">行動する</span>
        <p>まだ誰も見たことのない景色を求めて、自分たちの足で動き出す。</p>
      </div>
      <div class="concept">
        <span class="concept-word">創造する</span>
        <p>見たもの、感じたことを、言葉や映像にして形にしていく。</p>
      </div>
      <div class="concept">
        <span class="concept-word">整える</span>
        <p>経験を振り返り、自分の考えや価値観を整えて、次の一歩につなげる。</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== ギャラリー（自動スライド） ===== -->
<!-- 写真を増やすときは figure class="g-item" のかたまりをコピーして追加してください -->
<section id="gallery" class="section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div>
        <p class="eyebrow">GALLERY</p>
        <h2 class="h2">二人が見てきた景色</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="g-nav">
        <button type="button" class="g-btn" id="g-prev" aria-label="前の写真へ">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11 3L5 9l6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="g-btn" id="g-next" aria-label="次の写真へ">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 3l6 6-6 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
  // ===== note連携：記事一覧とニュースを data/ のファイルから表示 =====
  const NEW_DAYS = 7;          // 何日以内の記事に「NEW」を付けるか
  const NEWS_LIMIT = 6;        // ニュースに表示する件数
  const THEMES = ['夢', '将来', '趣味', '価値観'];

  const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
  const fmtDate = (iso) => {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    return isNaN(d) ? '' : `${d.getFullYear()}.${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };
  const isNew = (iso) => iso && (Date.now() - new Date(iso)) < NEW_DAYS * 864e5;
  const cleanTitle = (t) => t.replace(/^\s*【(夢|将来|趣味|価値観)】\s*/, '');

  const coverHTML = (src) => src
    ? `<div class="ph cover"><img class="cover-bg" src="${esc(src)}" alt="" aria-hidden="true" loading="lazy"><img class="cover-main" src="${esc(src)}" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>`
    : '<div class="ph">note</div>';
  let covers = {};

  function renderPosts(posts) {
    const box = document.getElementById('posts');
    box.innerHTML = posts.map((p) => `
      <article class="post" data-theme="${esc(p.theme || '')}" data-author="${esc(p.author)}">
        ${coverHTML(covers[p.link] || p.thumbnail)}
        <div class="post-meta">
          ${p.theme ? `<span class="tag">${esc(p.theme)}</span>` : ''}
          <span class="author-chip" data-who="${esc(p.author)}">${esc(p.author)}のnote</span><span>${fmtDate(p.date)}</span>
          ${isNew(p.date) ? '<span class="post-new">NEW</span>' : ''}
        </div>
        <h3>${esc(cleanTitle(p.title))}</h3>
        ${p.excerpt ? `<p>${esc(p.excerpt)}</p>` : ''}
        <a href="${esc(p.link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">noteで読む →</a>
      </article>`).join('');
  }

  function renderNews(posts, manual) {
    const items = [
      ...posts.map((p) => ({
        date: p.date, label: `${p.author}のnote`, info: false,
        html: `<span class="author-chip" data-who="${esc(p.author)}">${esc(p.author)}</span>のnoteを更新しました <a href="${esc(p.link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">「${esc(cleanTitle(p.title))}」</a>`
      })),
      ...manual.map((n) => ({
        date: n.date, label: n.label || 'お知らせ', info: true,
        html: n.link ? `<a href="${esc(n.link)}">${esc(n.text)}</a>` : esc(n.text)
      }))
    ].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date)).slice(0, NEWS_LIMIT);

    document.getElementById('news-list').innerHTML = items.length
      ? items.map((n) => `
        <li class="news-item">
          <time datetime="${esc(n.date)}">${fmtDate(n.date)}</time>
          <span class="news-label${n.info ? ' news-label-info' : ''}">${esc(n.label)}</span>
          <span class="news-text">${n.html}${isNew(n.date) ? '<span class="news-new">NEW</span>' : ''}</span>
        </li>`).join('')
      : '<li class="news-empty">お知らせはまだありません。</li>';
  }

  async function loadJSON(path) {
    const res = await fetch(path, { cache: 'no-cache' });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(path);
    return res.json();
  }

  async function loadNote() {
    // ファイルを直接ダブルクリックで開いたとき（file://）は読み込めないので見本のまま
    let data = null, manual = [];
    try {
      data = await loadJSON('data/posts.json');
      try { manual = await loadJSON('data/news.json'); } catch {}
      try { covers = await loadJSON('data/covers.json'); } catch {}
    } catch {
      // 読み込めないときは、ページ内に入っている控えのデータを使う（無ければ見本のまま）
      const fb = document.getElementById('note-fallback');
      if (!fb) return;
      ({ data, manual, covers = {} } = JSON.parse(fb.textContent));
    }
    const posts = data.posts || [];

    if (posts.length) renderPosts(posts);
    renderNews(posts, manual);
    if (data.updatedAt) document.getElementById('news-updated').textContent = `noteと同期：${fmtDate(data.updatedAt)}`;

    // 人ごとのnoteリンク（noteIdが空の人は「準備中」）
    if ((data.authors || []).length) {
      document.getElementById('note-links').innerHTML = data.authors.map((a) => a.url
        ? `<a href="${esc(a.url)}" class="note-link" data-who="${esc(a.name)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(a.name)}のnote →</a>`
        : `<span class="note-link note-link-pending" data-who="${esc(a.name)}">${esc(a.name)}のnote：準備中</span>`).join('');
      data.authors.forEach((a) => {
        document.querySelectorAll(`.profile-link[data-author="${a.name}"]`).forEach((el) => {
          el.outerHTML = a.url
            ? `<a href="${esc(a.url)}" class="profile-link" data-author="${esc(a.name)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(a.name)}のnoteを読む →</a>`
            : `<span class="profile-link profile-link-pending" data-author="${esc(a.name)}">${esc(a.name)}のnote：準備中</span>`;
        });
      });
    }
    applyFilter();
  }

  // ===== 記事の絞り込み（書いた人 × テーマ） =====
  const themeBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter[data-filter]');
  const authorBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter[data-author]');
  const empty = document.getElementById('empty');
  let currentFilter = 'すべて', currentAuthor = 'すべて';

  function applyFilter(theme = currentFilter, author = currentAuthor) {
    currentFilter = theme; currentAuthor = author;
    let count = 0;
    themeBtns.forEach(btn => btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', btn.dataset.filter === theme ? 'true' : 'false'));
    authorBtns.forEach(btn => btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', btn.dataset.author === author ? 'true' : 'false'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.post').forEach(post => {
      const show = (theme === 'すべて' || post.dataset.theme === theme)
                && (author === 'すべて' || post.dataset.author === author);
      post.hidden = !show;
      if (show) count++;
    });
    empty.style.display = count === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
  }

  themeBtns.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => applyFilter(btn.dataset.filter, currentAuthor)));
  authorBtns.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => applyFilter(currentFilter, btn.dataset.author)));
  document.querySelectorAll('.theme-card').forEach(card =>
    card.addEventListener('click', () => applyFilter(card.dataset.theme, currentAuthor))
  );
  loadNote();

  // メッセージフォーム（見た目のみ）
  document.getElementById('message-form').addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('form-note').textContent = 'ありがとうございます！（※送信機能はまだ準備中です）';
    e.target.reset();
  });


  // ===== トップの背景スライドショー =====
  const heroSlides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
  const heroDots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
  const pauseBtn = document.querySelector('.hero-pause');
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const HERO_INTERVAL = 5000; // 切り替え間隔（ミリ秒）
  let heroIndex = 0, heroTimer = null, heroPaused = reduceMotion;

  function showHero(i) {
    heroIndex = (i + heroSlides.length) % heroSlides.length;
    heroSlides.forEach((el, n) => el.classList.toggle('is-active', n === heroIndex));
    heroDots.forEach((el, n) => n === heroIndex ? el.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true') : el.removeAttribute('aria-current'));
  }
  function startHero() {
    clearInterval(heroTimer);
    if (!heroPaused) heroTimer = setInterval(() => showHero(heroIndex + 1), HERO_INTERVAL);
  }
  heroDots.forEach((dot, n) => dot.addEventListener('click', () => { showHero(n); startHero(); }));
  pauseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    heroPaused = !heroPaused;
    pauseBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', heroPaused ? 'true' : 'false');
    pauseBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', heroPaused ? 'スライドを再生' : 'スライドを一時停止');
    startHero();
  });
  pauseBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', heroPaused ? 'true' : 'false');
  startHero();

  // ===== ギャラリーの自動スライド =====
  const track = document.getElementById('g-track');
  const GALLERY_INTERVAL = 3500;
  let galleryTimer = null;
  function step() {
    const item = track.querySelector('.g-item');
    return item ? item.getBoundingClientRect().width + 20 : 300;
  }
  function slideGallery(dir) {
    const atEnd = track.scrollLeft + track.clientWidth >= track.scrollWidth - 4;
    const atStart = track.scrollLeft <= 4;
    if (dir > 0 && atEnd) track.scrollTo({ left: 0 });
    else if (dir < 0 && atStart) track.scrollTo({ left: track.scrollWidth });
    else track.scrollBy({ left: dir * step() });
  }
  function startGallery() {
    clearInterval(galleryTimer);
    if (!reduceMotion) galleryTimer = setInterval(() => slideGallery(1), GALLERY_INTERVAL);
  }
  function stopGallery() { clearInterval(galleryTimer); }
  document.getElementById('g-next').addEventListener('click', () => { slideGallery(1); startGallery(); });
  document.getElementById('g-prev').addEventListener('click', () => { slideGallery(-1); startGallery(); });
  ['mouseenter', 'focusin', 'touchstart'].forEach(ev => track.addEventListener(ev, stopGallery, { passive: true }));
  ['mouseleave', 'focusout', 'touchend'].forEach(ev => track.addEventListener(ev, startGallery, { passive: true }));
  startGallery();

  // コピーライトの年を自動表示
  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
</script>
</body>
</html>
